 Order

This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(2) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is preferred feeling aggrieved by award dated 18th of October, 2021 in MACC No.786 of 2018 by Member of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Katni (M.P.) whereby application filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming Rs.4,90,000/- compensation for personal injuries that occurred due to motor vehicle accident dated 15th of September, 2017, collision of a scooty driven by appellant with a car bearing registration number MP-21-CA-2811 driven by respondent no.1 and the aforesaid vehicle was in the ownership of the respondent no.1 and insured by respondent no.2.

sentences.text:
2. Tribunal awarded a total compensation of Rs.20,000/- in the head of medical expenses,
nutritious food, loss of income, fear, pain and suffering with interest 6 % p.a. from the date of application i.e. 16th of July, 2018.

3. This miscellaneous appeal has been preferred challenging the award and claimed enhancement of Rs.1,00,000/- on the ground that loss of income during treatment has not been taken into consideration properly.
Medical expenses and injury of the appellant has not been appreciated properly.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer of the appellant and prayed for rejection of the appeal.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
Considering the paragraph nos.15, 17 and 20 of the award, permanent disability is not proved.
In paragraph no.31 of the award, total medical expenses has been taken into consideration.

7. In paragraph no.30 of the award, the duration of treatment is mentioned as period of hospitalization from 15.09.2017 to 16.09.2017 at District Hospital Katni, on 21.09.2017 to 22.09.2017 at Shree Hospital, Bargawan Katni and consultation in Netaji Subhashchandra Bose Medical College, Jabalpur from 11.06.2017 to 28.09.2017, so the appellant is entitled for further enhancement of Rs.15,000/- under the second head of paragraph no.32 of the award.
